description: Recovered S-LDSC LD-score method (1 cM window, thin binary annotations, HM3 print list) with strict, explicit mapping rules. Changing any field requires a new profile id.

ld.annotation: binary union of intervals per annotation (overlapping and book-ended intervals merged)
ld.snp_membership: SNP at 1-based BP p is inside BED [s,e) iff s <= p-1 < e (make_annot.py semantics)

genes.gene_model: gene_span: GENCODE 'gene' record start..end (1-based inclusive) -> BED [start-1, end), then symmetric flank_bp, clipped to chromosome bounds
genes.symbol_matching: exact HGNC approved symbol; otherwise a unique HGNC alias/previous symbol; no case folding or fuzzy matching

chromosomes: autosomes 1-22; aliases chrN and N only
drop_policy: records are dropped only for categories listed in the annotation's allow_drop (non_autosomal, liftover_unmapped, gene_unmapped); ambiguous gene symbols always fail
